name: Esteban del Agua y Tierra (Tzimisce, Koldun of the Final Nights)

system.concept: Ambitious young koldun who seized the vanished Tremere antitribu's occult legacy
system.biography:
Background

Trained from childhood by his great-aunt Tia Oberta (a withered @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.revenants.JournalEntry.ldyqw2o2gR45LxDO]{Obertus} revenant witch) at horrific personal cost to himself and his family, Esteban rejected Vicissitude-as-purity, briefly joined the Children of the Dracon, then found the Old World's koldun hidebound and useless. The 1985 Mexico City earthquake was his breakthrough: he felt the earth's death throes and unlocked new koldunic power. After the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu chantry of Elena Vasquez vanished, Esteban and the Harbinger of Skulls La Viuda Blanca broke in and recovered much of her thaumaturgical library, making him one of the best-informed occultists in Mexico.

Roleplaying Hints

Esteban believes cataclysms have always served him and looks forward to the coming ones. He plays a precarious political balancing act between Old World koldun patrons, cardinals, and seraphs who all expect future service, while keeping Tia Oberta — limbless but alive on infusions of his blood — in a hidden closet-shrine beneath the northern colonias.
system.notes: Sire: Rafaela Lapaz. Pack-bonded (Vaulderie) with La Viuda Blanca. Disciplines as printed: Auspex 3, Koldunic Sorcery 4, Thaumaturgy 1, Vicissitude 1; Koldunic Paths: Way of Earth 4 (primary), Way of Water 3; Thaumaturgical Paths: Path of the Father's Vengeance 1 (primary).

system.description:
Combined with Vicissitude, this ritual lets a koldun assemble a vozhd war-ghoul from a mass of living victims. The Tzimisce must gather at least 15 ghouls, human or animal (20 or more is common), and force-feed all of them a concoction of one another's blood. A continuous chant is then maintained while Vicissitude reshapes the assembled ghouls into a single composite creature; the caster need not personally sculpt the flesh, though most prefer to. The casting requires (number of ghouls used minus 7) hours of unbroken chanting, and if this stretches past dawn the koldun must resist the day's pull to slumber.

System: Requires a minimum of 15 sacrificial ghouls each fed a portion of the shared blood mixture, an uninterrupted chant for the ritual's full duration, and a Vicissitude score sufficient to reshape the mass. If the chant is broken before completion, the ritual fails and the ghouls die without transformation.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: (Ghouls used - 7) hours to cast; permanent result

system.description:
Besides its steep prerequisites, only two Tzimisce in memory have ever employed this ritual, one of them the Dracon of Byzantium. It imbues the caster with the primordial energies of the Old Country, transforming her into a hideous dragon.

System: Requires Koldunic Sorcery (9) and Vicissitude (6). Upon successful casting, the Fiend's Strength triples and Stamina doubles, and she sprouts a scaly hide equivalent to heavy armor. The dragon-form may drink blood normally or devour the flesh of slain foes (an entire corpse can be consumed in a turn if the dragon does nothing else); for each victim's worth of flesh digested, the Fiend may later regurgitate corrosive, fiery acid inflicting aggravated damage. The form also grants substantial bonus Health Levels, though its sheer bulk makes the dragon easier to strike in return.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: Extended (dragon form persists until the koldun reverses it)

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge and concentrating for a turn, you establish a telepathic link with a visible subject, allowing thought communication and the extraction of certain truthful answers, with deeper secrets costing a Mental Trait per question.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: As long as contact is maintained

system.description: By touching an object and concentrating for a turn while spending a Mental Trait, you glimpse psychic impressions of powerful emotional events tied to it, possibly suffering a temporary derangement from particularly traumatic echoes.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: By touching a victim, you reshape flesh like clay, inflicting up to three Repugnant Negative Traits per use, or trading one Physical Trait for an extra health level (or the reverse) without inflicting damage.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent (heals as aggravated wound on weaker generations)

vtmlarp.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Three: Characters
